title: LEMONS!?!? (Fuuka over Totem)
description: Just a simple texture swap for the Totem of undying.
body:
All it is, is a texture swap really.
There isn't much to it lol.

When you die with a totem of undying, instead of a normal texture, it's Fuuka Yamagishi from persona 3 or reload I guess. 




Inspired by this stupid gif :)
